caseName: St. Louis Merchants' Bridge Terminal Railway Co. v. Callahan
caseNameFull: St. Louis Merchants' Bridge Terminal Railway Company, in Error v. Thomas Callahan

opinions.text: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri. Argued and submitted April 11, 1904. Decided April 18, 1904. Per Curiam. Judgment affirmed with costs, on the authority of Tullis v. Railroad Company, 175 U. S. 348, 351, and cases cited. Reported in state court, 170 Missouri, 473. Mr. Robert A. Holland, Jr., Mr. J. E. McKeighan and Mr. M. F. Watts for plaintiff in error. Mr. William F. Woerner for defendant in error.
